components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main submit action: rani-to-violet gradient with a pink glow and hover sheen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ff2d95, #d946ef, #7c3aed); color: #fff; font: 600 15px/1 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 14px 40px -12px rgb(255 45 149 / 0.75); transition: transform 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 20px 50px -12px rgb(255 45 149 / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: none; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffd577; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Gold Button
components.description: Secondary celebratory action, such as downloading the pass.
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ffd577, #f2a524); color: #07030f; font: 700 14px/1 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -10px rgb(255 194 74 / 0.7); transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-gold:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 16px 36px -10px rgb(255 194 74 / 0.85); } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffd577; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field with a gold focus ring; takes emerald or rose when the character is available or taken.
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; height: 48px; width: 100%; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); border-radius: 16px; background: rgb(7 3 15 / 0.55); color: #fff; font: 400 16px 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgb(127 107 168 / 0.8); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.2); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgb(255 213 119 / 0.6); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgb(255 213 119 / 0.1); }

components.name: Idea Chip
components.description: Quick-pick character suggestion; fills the form when tapped.
components.css: .ds-chip { padding: 6px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.04); color: #fff5d9; font: 500 12px 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 213 119 / 0.25); transition: transform 0.2s, background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-chip:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: rgb(255 213 119 / 0.1); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 213 119 / 0.5); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffd577; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Mode Tab
components.description: Pill tab bar with a gradient active state and a live count badge.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 4px; padding: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(13 7 25 / 0.75); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); } .ds-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: #c9b3f1; font: 600 14px 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s, color 0.3s; } .ds-tab:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05); color: #fff; } .ds-tab.is-active { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ff2d95, #7c3aed); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -8px rgb(255 45 149 / 0.85); } .ds-count { min-width: 24px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(46 233 208 / 0.15); color: #6ff7e3; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: The standard container: frosted plum glass with a gold-to-pink hairline across the top edge.
components.html:
Lock your character & entry pass

Claim your iconic Bollywood persona to generate your official VIP party pass.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; padding: 28px; border-radius: 28px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(35 19 62 / 0.68), rgb(17 9 33 / 0.78)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07), 0 40px 80px -32px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.85); color: #fbf7ff; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 8%; right: 8%; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgb(255 213 119 / 0.7), rgb(255 92 174 / 0.7), transparent); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card-copy { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: #c9b3f1; }

components.description: Live status under the character field: emerald when available, rose when taken.
components.html: “Geet” is available! Lock it in now for full main character energy.

narrative.overview:
A film premiere after dark: the stage is a deep plum night sky, swept by pink and teal spotlights, with a disco ball catching the light in each top corner. The event name is struck in gold foil like a title card, the word "Night" glows as a neon sign, and the guest's pass is the golden ticket that closes the story. The page should feel as though the party has already started.

The mood is glamorous, playful and celebratory. It is generous rather than precise: large rounded controls, candy gradients, soft glows, and sparkle. The one confirmed visual rejection is the generic SaaS or corporate-event look.
keyCharacteristics: Dark plum night sky lit by colored light, never a flat black or white field.
Gold foil display lettering with a script neon accent; sans-serif everywhere else.
Glass cards, glossy gradient buttons, and pill-shaped chips and tabs.
Depth from glow and blur; one hard drop shadow, reserved for the ticket.
The ticket is the loudest object on the page by design.

rules.name: The Foil Rule
rules.body: Gold foil gradient text is reserved for the event title and the ticket's title and "VIP" mark. If everything is gold, nothing is.

rules.name: The One Neon Rule
rules.body: Only one word on the page, "Night", carries the multi-layer neon glow. Every other glow is a soft colored shadow.

rules.name: The Meaning Rule
rules.body: Pink acts, gold celebrates, teal confirms, rose rejects. A color never changes its job between screens.

rules.name: The Two Display Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif display and script each appear once in the hero and once on the ticket. Everything functional is DM Sans.

rules.name: The Light-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Elevation is a colored glow or blur. Hard drop shadows are only for the ticket, so it reads as the one physical object in a world of light.

dos: Do keep the page phone first: controls at least 44px tall, 16px input text, one column, thumb-reachable primary action.
Do reserve gold foil for the event title and the ticket, and give "Night" the only neon glow.
Do let color carry meaning: pink acts, gold celebrates, teal confirms, rose rejects.
Do make the ticket the loudest object on the page, with the only hard drop shadow.
Do build depth from colored light and blur, and keep cards glass over the lit backdrop.
Do keep copy warm and filmy, but state errors plainly with who claimed the character and what to do next.
Do respect reduced motion: every animation collapses to an instant state.
donts: Don't drift toward a generic SaaS or corporate-event look: no flat white surfaces, plain form chrome, or default ticketing-platform styling.
Don't stack decorative effects on functional content; sparkles, props, and spotlights stay behind the cards and never intercept pointer events.
Don't use gold text, neon glow, or the display serif for ordinary UI copy.
Don't claim anything the demo cannot keep, such as a shared live roster across devices or real ticketing.
Don't use hard drop shadows on cards, buttons, or chips.
Don't change a status color's meaning; rose is never decorative and emerald is never an accent.
